name: Type-gated positive two-pool cytokine observation tail

statement.latest: y_hat(t) = b + (a-b)[w exp(-gamma_1 (t-t_a)) + (1-w) exp(-gamma_2 (t-t_a))], t>t_a, a>b>=0, gamma_1,gamma_2>0, 0<=w<=1.
statement.note_ascii: Exact algebra for a declared mixture of 2 independent linear decays, not a biological mechanism or universal inflammatory root law.

definitions.b: group mean baseline concentration in matching units
definitions.gamma_1: first positive decay rate, per hour
definitions.gamma_2: second positive decay rate, per hour
definitions.y_hat: conditional protein readout; no future observed biomarker allowed as input

parents.evidence: root context-dependent stepper; still an abstract declaration
quotient/readout dynamic commutation remains unverified biologically
reader equivalence depends on analyte, assay and time
observable apparent stationarity may hide internal states

origin.source: docs/proposals/PROP-IMF-02.md; model implementation in morrocwi/birca_admin_5.0 draft PR #18; training PMID 16403844; testing PMID 23547245

claim_boundary: Finite retrospective group-mean post-anchor decay readout only, 21.352459% normalized error on 6 Kullmann protein-time pairs; not blind, not tested on patient-level data, not a universal biological mechanism, no clinical decisions.
